column1: # area_map.tsv -- THE CARRIER MAP OF THE AREA SMOKE (coo 2026-09-28, row instruments-the-area-smoke-...-ceo-1342; Lon's sixth
# question, verbatim: "So how will each HQ know to consult this attribute table to determine the set of tests to run for that
# language?" -- THE SEAT MUST NOT HAVE TO KNOW). test_area_smoke.sh with no argument reads the landing's diff against
# origin/main and maps every touched file and changed function through THIS table to the feature columns of the attribute
# tables (ALL.csv), then runs the union through corpus_suite_harness.py smoke.
# FORMAT: feature<TAB>carrier, whole-line comments only. A CARRIER is one of
#   a file      relative to SCRIP/, e.g. src/templates/bb/bb_match_span.cpp
#   a directory relative to SCRIP/, trailing slash, covering every file under it, e.g. src/parsers/snobol4/
#   a symbol    a bare C identifier: the function a -U0 hunk header names, e.g. sno_capt_body
# A FEATURE is a column name exactly as the tables spell it (FENCE, scan, cut, record ...), or one of the two widenings:
#   *           every feature column of every table (a SHARED NODE reaches every language -- the CEO-405 widening)
#   lang:<x>    every feature column of the tables under tests/<x> and packages/<x>/ (a frontend or lowerer of one language)
#   <x>:<col>   that column in the tables of language x only -- the form for a column several languages share whose carrier is
#               one language's own (its lowerer): the unqualified name would select every language's column of that name
# A carrier mapped to `-` carries NO area (src/tools/, a test helper): touching it owes no smoke, and the wrapper says so.
# ⛔ A touched src/ file with no row here REFUSES the smoke rc=2 naming the file -- the lander adds the row with its landing.
# ⛔ The gate test_gate_area_smoke_reads_the_attribute_rows.sh keeps every feature column of every runnable table named in an
# explicit row and every carrier existing in the tree; a row naming a file that has moved is a red, not a stale entry.
# ---- SHARED NODES: every language reaches them (the CEO-405 widening) ----
# ---- NO AREA: helpers no graded program runs through ----
# ---- ONE LANGUAGE'S FRONTEND OR LOWERER: every feature of that language ----
# a column several languages share, carried by ONE language's lowerer, is qualified <lang>:<column> on each lowerer: an unqualified
# row on lower_icon.c selected Raku's and Pascal's while on every Icon lowerer landing (the coo 2026-10-11, the first verifier batch)
# ---- SNOBOL4 / Snocone / Rebus pattern features: the match boxes ----
# ---- Icon features: the scan boxes, generators and co-expressions ----
# Icon generators (the coo 2026-10-10): 7a5aa2f9a deleted the Raku grammar prototype bb_glit.cpp and bb_galt.cpp with the rows that had
# carried element_gen and gen_with_alternation, and renamed every to gen_with_every, a column no table has -- so test_gate_area_smoke_
# reads_the_attribute_rows.sh arm 7a read three Icon columns unmapped. Their carriers: Icon's !x lowers to IR_ITERATE (bb_iterate.cpp, the
# every loop's box too), and alternation in a generator is lower_alt / lower_alt_impl in src/lower/lower_icon.c.
# Icon sections s[i:j], s[i+:n], s[i-:n] (the coo 2026-10-15, CEO-1679 tier 1: aeea98779 broke every string section in a small procedure and no core entry took one): the section
# column is the 62nd attribute column; its carriers are the section templates and the runtime that answers a section (subscript_get2_s and its callers, rt_substr).
